johto_newgame_intro: Your own room in New Bark Town, where the wind smells of new beginnings.
Professor Elm's Lab is just next door. Time to head downstairs!
johto_mom_home: Mom: Oh, you look tired, honey!
johto_rival_mom: My son {rival_name} is out exploring Johto right now.
He said he was going to become the greatest Math Master!
You look tired, why don't you rest here for a moment?
Give my regards to your mother in Pallet Town!
johto_mom_neighbor: It's so quiet with him gone...
johto_elm_intro: Professor Elm: Hi! I'm Professor Elm. My lab studies how Pokemon evolve and hatch.
Three young Pokemon here are looking for a trainer: Chikorita, Cyndaquil and Totodile.
johto_elm_errand: Take this Egg back to Professor Elm immediately!
That egg is a true mystery of the world!
johto_elm_congrats: Professor Elm: Incredible! You're the Kanto Champion!
Oak told me all about your math-powered battles.
I've updated your Pokédex to include Johto species.
And I've added a Johto page to your Badge Case!
There is a whole new world of Pokémon to discover!
You received the NATIONAL DEX and JOHTO BADGE CASE!
kurt_intro: Kurt: Team Rocket has taken over the Slowpoke Well!
They're cutting off tails to sell them for profit!
I'm going down there to stop them myself!
Wait... my back! Ouch ouch ouch...
Young trainer, please! Go to the Well and stop those crooks!
kurt_reward: Kurt: You did it! The Slowpoke are safe and their tails are growing back.
Team Rocket won't be bothering Azalea Town for a while.
bill_johto_intro: I was just checking on the PC system here in Ecruteak.
You look like a promising math trainer.
If you're ever in Goldenrod, come visit my house!
I have some rare Eevee eggs I'm researching.
lance_mahogany_intro: Lance: I've tracked the source of the high-frequency signal to this shop.
Team Rocket is hiding a massive base beneath Mahogany Town.
They are forcing Pokémon to evolve using artificial radio waves!
I will go ahead and scout. Follow me when you are ready!
lance_mahogany_cleared: Lance: Excellent work. Team Rocket's radio signal has been cut off.
The Dragon's Den in Blackthorn is your next destination.
kimono_girls_intro: We are the Kimono Girls of Ecruteak.
We dance to honor the legends of the towers.
A master of math and heart may one day see the rainbow bird.
jasmine_lighthouse_intro: Jasmine: Amphy is sick and the lighthouse can't shine.
There is a pharmacy in Cianwood City that has a special medicine.
But I cannot leave Amphy alone... please, could you go for me?
Cianwood is across the sea, to the west. Please, take the lift down - I'll unlock it for you.
jasmine_lighthouse_medicine: Jasmine: You brought the medicine from Cianwood?
Thank you so much! Please, give it to Amphy!
I cannot thank you enough. Math truly connects all hearts.
amphy_cured: The light in its tail begins to glow brightly!
pharmacist_reward: Pharmacist: You came from Olivine for Jasmine's Amphy?
I have just the thing. It's a very strong medicine!
euskine_intro: Eusine: I'm searching for the legendary Suicune.
It is said to be the embodiment of the North Wind.
eusine_suicune_defeated: You tell Eusine about your math-powered victory over Suicune.
Eusine: What?! You actually cornered Suicune in battle?
I've spent years chasing its shadow, and you... you've already faced it with your math!
I'm jealous, but also impressed. Suicune chooses only the most brilliant minds.
I'll continue my search. We will meet again!
dragon_elder_intro: Elder: You must answer the test of the Dragon Den!
Do you treat your Pokémon with love? Or as tools for math?
dragon_elder_pass: Elder: You have proven your compassion and math skill.
The dragon master Clair has much to learn from you.
giovanni_tohjo_intro: Giovanni: How? How can you have found me here?
I am Giovanni, the leader of Team Rocket.
I will not let a child stand in the way of my return!
giovanni_tohjo_won: Giovanni: This math... it surpasses even my ambition.
Take this. Use it to catch the ultimate power.
radio_tower_grunt_deny: The Director is... uh... busy with important business.
No tours today! Come back when you have 7 badges!
radio_tower_grunt_battle: You again? I told you to scram!
Wait... those badges! You're that math genius from the news!
I'm not letting you through to the Director!
flower_shop_intro: Welcome to the Goldenrod Flower Shop!
Our flowers are blooming beautifully today.
flower_shop_reward: Oh! You defeated Whitney? That's amazing!
You'll need this to get past that strange wiggling tree on Route 36.
It hates being watered, so be ready for a battle!

boss.name: Kyogre
lines: A powerful presence fills the air... Kyogre appears!

boss.name: Rayquaza
lines: The Jade Orb glows... Rayquaza descends from the sky!
A White Flute, lying in the grass.
A Rare Candy, lying in the grass.
A Revive, dropped by the path.
A Lagging Tail, tucked behind a tree.
A Wave Incense, left near a ledge.
My husband practically lives at the lab, buried in his research.
Our boy keeps hoping you'll come by and show him your Pokemon!
Elm's aide: You're off to see Mr. Pokemon? Then you'll want these, in case your Pokemon gets hurt.
done: Elm's aide: Use a Potion when your Pokemon is hurt. Good luck out there!
fail: Elm's aide: The Professor's been waiting for you all morning!

lines: Guide Gent: Welcome to Cherrygrove! Let me show you around.
The Pokemon Center heals your team for free, any time.
The Mart sells Poke Balls and Potions. Stock up before a long trip!
Route 30 is north, up the sand road past the Mart. Mr. Pokemon lives that way.
Here, let me load the Town Map onto your Pokegear. It shows you where you are, wherever you go!
done: Guide Gent: Your Pokegear's Town Map shows all of Johto. Enjoy the trip!

lines: Fisherman: This water comes from a spring that never runs dry.
A Water-type Pokemon that holds it hits harder. Here, it's yours!
Fisherman: Give that Mystic Water to a Water-type to hold. It makes a big splash!
Pokemon grow through battle. Some even change their whole form!
Did you know every Pokemon has its own nature? I hear it changes how its stats grow.

intro: ...You got a Pokemon at the lab. What a waste.
A wimp like you doesn't deserve it.
...Don't you get what I'm saying?
Well, I too have a good Pokemon. I'll show you what I mean!
player_won: ...Humph! Are you happy you won?
player_lost: ...Humph. I knew it. You're weak.

requirements.fail_text: The Gym Leader, Falkner, is currently meditating at the top of the Sprout Tower. You must defeat Elder Li to prove your worth first!

intro: Welcome to the Violet City Gym! I'm Falkner, the Flying-type Gym Leader.
player_won: We failed to take flight
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

lines: A Poke Ball, lying by the path.
A Rare Candy, left on the ground.
Welcome, welcome, to Earl's Pokemon Academy! Learn, learn, and learn some more, yes!
I'm copying down the lecture... and everything on the blackboard too.
Some Berries heal Pokemon, and lots of other items can be held... There's so much to remember!
The Pokemon I just traded for came holding something!
I traded my best Pokemon to the boy sitting next to me.
Every kind of Pokemon has its own Ability. Some kinds can have one of two!
My daughter names her Pokemon after the foods she loves best.
My Pidgey's name is Strawberry!
STRAWBERRY: Pidgey!
A Pokemon you trade for grows fast. But without the right Badge, it might not listen to you.

fail: Kyle: I collect Pokemon. Got a Bellsprout? I'd trade my Onix for one!
lines: Kyle: A Bellsprout! Will you swap it for my Onix, Rocky? Thanks a lot!
Kyle: How's Rocky doing? My new Bellsprout and I are getting along great!
Elm's aide: There you are! The Professor asked me to bring you this. It's the Egg from Mr. Pokemon.
Elm's aide: He thinks it will hatch if a strong trainer carries it around. Take good care of it!
done: Elm's aide: Has the Egg hatched yet? The Professor can't wait to hear!

lines: Primo: Bonjour! Surely you know me, Primo, the star of The Show Me Show!

travel_options.message: The Unown on the walls seem to stare at Arceus... The world goes white. You're somewhere cold.

lines: An Escape Rope, lying by the path.
A Potion, left on the ground.

fail_text: Bugsy is helping Kurt protect the Slowpoke! Stop Team Rocket in the Slowpoke Well to bring him back to the Gym.

intro: Welcome to the Azalea Town Gym! I'm Bugsy, the Bug-type Gym Leader.
player_won: You really bugged me!
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

lines: The Slowpoke are gone from town... Maybe the forest's guardian is angry with us.
If our Farfetch'd don't come home, we can't cut wood for charcoal. My apprentice went looking in Ilex Forest.
You found our Farfetch'd and chased off Team Rocket! Sorry, I forgot to thank you properly.
Here's some charcoal I made.
done: A Pokemon holding Charcoal hits harder with Fire-type moves. You're the coolest!
fail: Where did all the Slowpoke go? Are they off playing somewhere?

intro: Welcome to the Goldenrod City Gym! I'm Whitney, the Normal-type Gym Leader.
player_won: You're pretty good at this!
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

travel_options.message: You board the Magnet Train. It races underground toward Saffron City in Kanto!

lines: Voltorb Flip is all about the numbers on the side. Read them right and you'll never flip a Voltorb... much.
The higher the level, the more each card pays. And the more Voltorb hide under them!
Flipped a Voltorb on my very last card. Again!
I'm saving my coins for a Porygon. The prize window has one for the patient.
Shh! I'm on a winning streak, don't jinx it!
I want the Up-Grade for my Porygon. Only a few thousand coins to go...
Man: Hey, kid! I found this in the Underground, but I never play the slots.
Take it! A Coin Case lets you play at the Game Corner.
Attendant: Congratulations on becoming Champion! We've been keeping something for you.
Attendant: It's a strange ball that came to us here. Nobody knows how to open it. Perhaps Kurt in Azalea Town could tell you more.
done: Attendant: Have you shown that GS Ball to Kurt yet?

lines: The department store has a fine selection. Some things, though, you can only win at the Game Corner.
I'm raring to shop again today!
My mom's great at bargain hunting. She always finds things cheaper!
The ladies here greet even kids like me politely. That's what I call service!
I won my Abra at the Game Corner. Now it's my best partner!
A store this big shows what a big city Goldenrod is. Nowhere else has a selection like it.
I-I-I can't wait for anything! I use X Speed in battle to hurry my Pokemon up!
Ever tried X Sp. Atk? It really cranks up Special Attack!
I love strong Pokemon. I feed mine Protein to pump up their Attack.
Iron raises your Pokemon's Defense. Good stuff!
Some Pokemon only evolve when you trade them. Machoke, Kadabra, Haunter and Graveler, I think!
You can't rename a Pokemon you got in a trade. The name was its first Trainer's choice.
On Sundays a lady comes to check on people's Pokemon. She even gives away TMs!

fail: I collect Pokemon. Got a Drowzee? I'd trade my Machop for one!
lines: A Drowzee! Will you swap it for my Machop? Thanks a lot!
How's my old Machop doing? Training hard, I hope!
Oh, what a cute Pokemon! Let me see how it feels about you...
wait: I've already given you a TM this week. Come back next Sunday!

lines: Tired? Have a drink from the vending machines. Your Pokemon will love them too!
Do you listen to the radio? I love Buena's Password!
Whitney: What a coincidence! Fancy meeting you up here. Let's swap phone numbers!
Whitney was registered in the phone!
done: Whitney: Miltank and I are training hard. Call me sometime!

lines: Oh, you collect Pokemon? My son Bill is an expert. He's been called to the Pokemon Center in Ecruteak City.
My big brother Bill made the Pokemon Storage System!
Once, my Pokemon couldn't use any moves at all. Their PP had run out!
If a Pokemon can't use its moves, heal it at a Pokemon Center or use an Ether.
If you treat your Pokemon kindly, they'll love you back. Let me see your first Pokemon...
When I use an item on my Pokemon, it looks so pleased!
I keep losing, and my Pokemon keep fainting... Maybe that's why they don't like me much.
Hello, hello! I'm the official Name Rater. Every Pokemon deserves a name to be proud of!
Which of your Pokemon shall I rate?
Could you do me a favour? My friend's on Route 31, dozing by the pond. Please take him my Spearow, Kenya. She's carrying a letter for him!

fail: My friend's on Route 31, by the pond. Kenya knows the way... I hope!
lines: You delivered the letter? Thank you! Here, take this for your trouble.
done: Kenya's doing well with you, I see. Look after her!

lines: Funny how a tiny change turns a Pokegear into a radio. Yours doesn't have one? Shame!
Long ago Professor Oak said there were 150 kinds of Pokemon. Now there are many more!
A higher-level Pokemon doesn't always win. Types matter too!
Clerk: Welcome to the Daily Drawing Corner! $300 a draw, once a day: a Berry, a Poke Ball... or a TM!
Attendant: Welcome aboard! Which floor, please?
Don: I'm after a Venonat... no, something even better! Out of my way!
VENONAT: It's following Don around the park.
Ed: My Butterfree and I came first last time. We're not losing today!
BUTTERFREE: It's following Ed around the park.
Nick: A Scyther would score big. That's what I'm hunting.
SCYTHER: It's following Nick around the park.
Beverly: Isn't my Snubbull adorable? Oh, the contest? I'm just here for the fun of it!
SNUBBULL: It's following Beverly around the park.
Samuel: Pinsir and I are going to find the biggest bug in the park!
PINSIR: It's following Samuel around the park.

call: It's Jack! I've been studying the type chart. Battle me at the National Park!
Hello, it's Beverly! My Snubbull got a gift for you. Come to the National Park!

lines: A Soothe Bell, lying in the grass.
A Paralyze Heal, dropped by the path.
A TM (Dig), tucked behind a tree.

fail_text: Morty is at the Burned Tower, searching for the legendary Pokemon. Go and find him there first!
(If your rival beat you there, go back in and battle him again.)

intro: Welcome to the Ecruteak City Gym! I'm Morty, the Ghost-type Gym Leader.
player_won: You're a skilled trainer!
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

lines: When I was little, the sky went dark all at once. A huge Flying-type Pokemon was blotting out the sun!
It flew off toward the sea. I've never forgotten it.
A Pokemon that big? If it's real, it must be terribly strong.
You're off on an adventure with your Pokemon? Then you'll need to hunt for treasure! Here, take this.
done: Lots of items lie hidden where you can't see them. Use the Dowsing Machine and it'll point them out!

lines: A book: the History of Ecruteak.
Two towers once stood here, each the roost of a mighty Flying-type Pokemon. One burned...
...and three Pokemon that raced across the land were said to be born from its ashes.

fail_text: Jasmine is at the Lighthouse, caring for the sick Ampharos.
She won't leave its side until it gets medicine from Cianwood.

intro: Welcome to the Olivine City Gym! I'm Jasmine, the Steel-type Gym Leader.
player_won: Jasmine: ...You are a better trainer than me, in both skill and kindness.
Please take this Mineral Badge.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

travel_options.message: You board the S.S. Aqua. The ship sails east across the sea to Kanto...
The ferry sails south for days over warm seas... Land ho! It's Valencia Island!

lines: Sailor: This ferry sails south to the Orange Islands.
It only takes the Champion of both Kanto and Johto. Come back when you've won both!
A TM (Drain-Punch), lying by the path.
Olivine's right on the sea, and where there's sea, there's fish! I've fished here thirty years.
You look like you've got an angler's soul. Take this rod and try it for yourself!
done: How's the fishing? Land the big one yet?

lines: Olivine Cafe's menu is packed with hearty food for hungry sailors!
Gobble, gobble... Ack! Choking! ...Whew. I should chew before I swallow.
Every time I'm in Olivine I eat here. It makes me feel strong as an ox!
Training going well? In the mountains you sometimes find Pokemon nobody's ever seen before, you know.
I'm looking for a Krabby! Would you trade one for my Voltorb, Billy? He's holding a Berry, too.
done: The Krabby you traded me is doing great! I hope Billy is too.

lines: Whenever I'm naughty, Daddy says he'll send me away!
On the way to Cianwood there are four little islands. Naughty kids get sent there!

intro: Welcome to the Cianwood City Gym! I'm Chuck, the Fighting-type Gym Leader.
player_won: Chuck: WAHAHAH! You've got real power in those sums!
I lost fair and square. Take the Storm Badge!
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

lines: Eusine: I'm Eusine. I've been chasing Suicune for years.
You've seen it too? Then show me what kind of trainer you are!

player_won: Eusine: ...I see why Suicune keeps appearing near you.

lines: A boy about your age with piercing eyes and long red hair came by... He scared me half to death!
What if he comes back for my Pokemon? Please, will you look after my Shuckle for me? His name's Shuckie.
done: Is Shuckie well? For a Pokemon, happiness is being with someone who treats it kindly.

lines: You came from Olivine? Remember the four islands on the way? They say a mythical sea creature lives there.
The whirlpools round those islands are caused by the sea creature, I've heard. You'd need a special move to get past them.
They say it only shows itself to someone carrying a special bell, the kind the Kimono Girls of Ecruteak keep.
Hi! You must be a sightseer! Let me take a picture of you and your team.
Have you heard of the Bell Tower in Ecruteak? They say a bell at its top rings clear when the legendary Pokemon is near.

fail_text: Something strange is going on in Mahogany. Pryce won't battle while Team Rocket is in town.
Maybe the trouble at the Lake of Rage is connected...

intro: Welcome to the Mahogany Town Gym! I'm Pryce, the Ice-type Gym Leader.
player_won: Your math burned right through my defense.
Take the Glacier Badge, and this TM: Hail.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

lines: They say a red Gyarados showed up at the Lake of Rage. Odd, when even ordinary Gyarados are rare round here...
My favourite radio show? Pokemon Music, easily.
Lance: So you came. I'm Lance, a Trainer like you. That red Gyarados was forced to evolve, and the trail led here.
Lance: This shop is a front for Team Rocket's hideout. Dragonite, Hyper Beam! ...There. The stairs behind the counter go down.
Lance: They're sending out a signal that's driving the lake's Pokemon wild. Let's shut it down together. Dragonite and I will go down with you.
DRAGONITE: Gyafooha!

fail_text: Clair only accepts challengers who have earned seven Johto badges.

leader.name: Clair
badge_later_lines: Clair: ...I still don't accept it. Go to the Dragon's Den behind this Gym.
Clair: Pass the Elder's test at the Dragon Shrine, and then... we'll talk about the Rising Badge.

intro: Welcome to the Blackthorn City Gym! I'm Clair, the Dragon-type Gym Leader.
player_won: Clair: I lost? I don't believe it. There must be some mistake...
Clair: I won't admit this. I won't give you the Rising Badge!
Clair: ...Fine. There's a place called the Dragon's Den behind this Gym. Go to the Dragon Shrine at its heart and take the Elder's test. If you pass, I'll accept you as a Trainer worthy of the Badge.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

lines: A clan of Trainers who command Dragon-type Pokemon lives right here in Blackthorn.
That's why so many Dragon Tamers come from this town.
DRATINI: Draa!
Dragonair is so cute, but I don't have one! Will you trade yours for my Dodrio, Doris? She's holding something nice.
done: Your Dragonair's so cute! How's Doris doing?

lines: Um... who did you say I was again? ...Oh, right! I'm the Move Deleter! Or I was.
Back in my day, a Pokemon could only remember four moves. FOUR! You'd come to me in tears to make room for a new one.
Now your Pokemon keep every move they ever learn, and you just pick four from the Summary. Nobody needs forgetting anymore.
...What was I saying? Oh, never mind. I forgot.
A Heart Scale! Hand it over and I'll help your Pokemon remember a move it forgot... is what I used to say.
These days nothing's ever forgotten! Every move is right there in the Summary, all the time. Technology!
Forty years of tutoring, replaced by a menu. I keep the Heart Scales for my collection now. Want to see? ...No? Fair.
Hohoho... They call me Grandma Wilma. I sense a little talent as a Dragon Tamer in you.
Let me teach the strongest Dragon move there is, Draco Meteor, to a Dragon that loves you dearly.
fail: Grandma Wilma: Only a Dragon-type Pokemon can master Draco Meteor. Bring me one!
not_close: Grandma Wilma: Your Dragon isn't close enough to you yet. Spend more time together, and come back.

lines: Your quest for power has brought you here... Very well. The ultimate moves, for the fully grown first partners who love you most.
fail: None of your Pokemon can master that move. Only the final form of a first partner can!
not_close: It could learn it, but its heart isn't yet one with yours. Come back when you're inseparable.

intro: ...Hold it.
Are you going to take the Pokemon League challenge?
...Don't make me laugh. You're so much weaker than I am.
I'm not like I was before. I now have the best and strongest Pokemon with me!
player_won: ...I haven't given up on becoming the greatest Trainer...
I'm going to find out why I can't win and become stronger.
When I do, I will challenge you. And I'll beat you down with all my power.
...Humph! You keep at it until then.
player_lost: ...Humph! I knew it. Go home, the League isn't for you.

lines: A Max Elixir, lying among the rocks.
A Max Revive, in a dark corner.
A Full Heal, beside the cave wall.
A Potion, left behind by a hiker.
A TM (Earthquake), lying among the rocks.
A Hp Up, in a dark corner.
A Full Restore, beside the cave wall.
An Ultra Ball, left behind by a hiker.
A TM (Dark-Pulse), lying among the rocks.
A TM (Flamethrower), lying by the path.
Mr. Pokemon: Hm? What's that? A red scale!
Is it from a Gyarados? How fascinating! Would you trade it for this?
Here, a set of vitamins! They make a Pokemon stronger.

call: Ahoy, it's Huey! My Pokemon and I are ready. Come to the Lighthouse!

lines: A Rare Candy, lying among the rocks.
An Ether, in a dark corner.
A TM (Swagger), lying among the rocks.
A TM (Charge-Beam), lying among the rocks.
A Super Repel, lying by the path.

call: It's Reena! I'm stronger now. Rematch on Route 27?
Jose here! My Farfetch'd found something sparkly for you. Route 27!

lines: A Moon Stone, lying in the grass.
A Rare Candy, dropped by the path.
A TM (Dragon-Claw), tucked behind a tree.
Off to the Pokemon League? Then your Pokemon had better trust you. Let me see your partner...
Yes, the two of you are close. Take this TM - it's Sandstorm.
fail: Off to the Pokemon League? Then your Pokemon had better trust you. Let me see your partner...
Hmm. It doesn't quite trust you yet. Spend more time together and come back.
done: Sandstorm stirs up a storm of sand that hurts every Pokemon but Rock, Ground and Steel types.

call: Gaven here. I've trained hard on Route 26. Come test my team!

lines: A Destiny Knot, lying in the grass.
Lucky you, finding a place to rest right where the road gets hard! Make yourself at home.
There! Your Pokemon look full of fight again. Keep it up!
Celebrity: You found my hideaway! I came out here to rest after years in the spotlight.
Celebrity: Well, since you're not the press... Take this. My debut dress was inspired by this move: Steel Wing.
done: Celebrity: Shh! Not a word to anyone that I'm out here, all right?

lines: A TM (Brine), lying in the grass.
A Black Flute, lying among the rocks.

call: Hey, it's Joey! My Rattata's gotten way tougher. It's in the top percentage of Rattata, I swear! Come battle me on Route 30!

lines: A Potion, lying in the grass.
An Antidote, dropped by the path.
People usually knock here looking for Mr. Pokemon's house.
But you came to see me, didn't you? How kind! Here's something for you.
done: With that Apricorn Box you can carry all the Apricorns you find.
Each tree grows its own colour. Pick them once a day, and take them to Kurt in Azalea Town!

call: It's Wade! My bugs have been training hard on Route 31. Want to see? I've got a Berry for you too!

lines: A Potion, lying in the grass.
A Potion, dropped by the path.

call: Hi, it's Liz! I just had to call you! My Pokemon are so much stronger now. Battle me on Route 32?
Ralph here! The fish are biting and my team's in fine shape. Come test it on Route 32!

lines: A Leppa Berry, lying in the grass.
A Repel, dropped by the path.
A Great Ball, tucked behind a tree.
A TM (Bullet-Seed), left near a ledge.
This is a great spot for fishing! Watching everyone out there, don't you want to try?
Here, take this Old Rod!
done: Face the water and use the Rod. Watch closely, and reel in when something bites!

lines: What should my Pokemon hold? Maybe something that boosts its Attack...
Bonjour! You collect Apricorns too? How wonderful!
Take this Lure Ball. It works best on Pokemon you fish up.
done: Kurt is every Apricorn collector's hero. Visit him in Azalea Town!
fail: Bonjour! Are you picking Apricorns? Get an Apricorn Box first, then come see me.

call: Anthony here! I've been climbing all day, and my Pokemon are tough as rock. Rematch on Route 33?
Hi, it's Gina! My Pokemon grew so much. Battle me on Route 34? I have something for you, too!
It's Todd! My Pokemon and I trained in the wild. Come battle us on Route 34!

lines: An Ether, lying in the grass.
A Nugget, dropped by the path.

call: Arnie here! I caught a really neat bug on Route 35. Come see how strong my team's gotten!

lines: An Ultra Ball, lying in the grass.
A TM (Payback), dropped by the path.
I hear Bug-type lovers come from all over for the Bug-Catching Contest in the National Park!
Tap, tap, ding, ding! We're building the Pokeathlon Dome up ahead. It's not ready yet, sorry!

call: It's Alan! I studied up on battling. Meet me on Route 36! Oh, and I found something for you.

lines: A Shiny Stone, lying in the grass.

call: Hi, it's Dana! I've got a present for you, and my team's ready for a rematch. Route 38!
Chad here! I learned a new strategy in class. Let's battle on Route 38!

lines: A Hp Up, lying in the grass.
A Max Potion, dropped by the path.

call: It's Derek! My Pikachu is the cutest ever. I found something shiny for you - come to Route 39!

lines: A Lax Incense, lying in the grass.
My Miltank's stopped giving milk. This farm's famous for its milk, and everyone wants a drink...
You made our Moomoo well again, hon! Our milk goes all the way to Kanto, so we were in real trouble. Here's something for your trouble.
done: That's Natural Gift. Its power and type depend on the Berry your Pokemon's holding.
fail: Our milk goes all the way to Kanto. If Moomoo won't give milk, we're in a real fix.

lines: Moomoo is sick... She needs lots of Oran Berries.
Thank you! Moomoo is totally healthy again!
Moomoo is sick... She needs lots of Oran Berries.
Moomoo's all better! We sell her milk at the house. Don't forget to drop by!
MOOMOO: ...Moo... Its cry is weak.

fail: It looks hungry. Maybe a Berry would help?
more: It still looks weak. It needs more Berries.
well: MOOMOO: Mooo! It's brimming with energy again!

done: MOOMOO: Mooo! It's brimming with energy.

lines: My Miltank's milking again, thanks to you! Here, have a bottle any time.
A Super Potion, lying in the grass.

call: Tully here! I fished up something odd for you, and my team's in top form. Route 42!

won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Elm's Errand
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Travel to Route 30 to visit Mr. Pokemon. He has a discovery that Prof. Elm needs to see!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Unown Researcher
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Ruins of Alph are mysterious. Catch at least 5 different forms of Unown!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Odd Egg
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Day-Care Man on Route 34 has found another odd Egg. Go and see him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mystery Egg
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You've got Mr. Pokemon's egg! Return to the Lab in New Bark Town to show Prof. Elm the Mystery Egg.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Sprout Tower Challenge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Sages of Sprout Tower in Violet City hold a secret power. Defeat Elder Li to prove your worth.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Taking Flight
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Falkner at the Violet City Gym. His Flying-type Pokemon soar high—use your math to bring them down!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Slowpoke Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Elm's aide is waiting in Violet City with something for you. Then head south through Union Cave: Team Rocket is cutting off Slowpoke tails in Azalea Town! Stop them at the Slowpoke Well.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Bugging Out
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the Well cleared, Bugsy is back at the Azalea Gym. Defeat his scuttling team for the Hive Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Weird Tree
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A strange tree is blocking Route 36. Visit Goldenrod City to find a way to make it move.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lost in Ilex Forest
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The charcoal maker's Farfetch'd ran off into Ilex Forest, and a little tree blocks the way north. Find the charcoal maker in the forest: he'll teach you Cut.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Plain Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Goldenrod is buzzing about a strange tree on Route 36 that nobody can get past. Then there's Whitney at the Goldenrod Gym: tougher than she looks! Defeat her Miltank to earn your third badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Shadows of Ecruteak
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Explore the Burned Tower in Ecruteak City. Legends say three beastly Pokemon are slumbering in the basement.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Fog Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Morty can see things others cannot. Use your logic to navigate the Ecruteak Gym and defeat his Ghost-types.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Storm Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: While in Cianwood, challenge Chuck at the Gym. His Fighting-type Pokemon will test your math stamina!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mineral Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Take the Secret Potion to Amphy at the top of the Olivine Lighthouse. Then challenge Jasmine at the Gym: her Steel-type Pokemon have a rock-solid defense.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lighthouse Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Jasmine's Ampharos is ill! First get Surf: chase off the Rocket Grunt bothering the Kimono Girls at Ecruteak's Dance Theater. Climb Olivine's Lighthouse to see what's wrong, then cross the sea to Cianwood City for the Secret Potion from its pharmacy.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rage at the Lake
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Something is wrong at the Lake of Rage north of Mahogany Town. Investigate the rumor of a Red Gyarados, then help Lance clear out the Rocket hideout under Mahogany's souvenir shop.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Glacier Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Before you leave the hideout, collect HM Whirlpool: it's your thanks for clearing it out. Then face Pryce, a master of Ice-type Pokemon: keep a cool head and defeat him at the Mahogany Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Radio Tower Takeover
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Rocket has seized the Radio Tower in Goldenrod City! Beat the fake Director for the Basement Key, free the real one in the Goldenrod Underground, then use his Card Key to reach the top. The road east of Mahogany stays shut till you do.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Rising Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Clair of Blackthorn City won't accept your strength easily. On your way through the Ice Path, find HM Waterfall in its icy corner. Then defeat Clair and pass the Elder's test at the Dragon Shrine, out on the water in the Dragon's Den (Surf and Whirlpool).

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Conquer the League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Johto journey ends at the Silver League, past Victory Road. Defeat the Elite Four and become the Johto Champion!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wise Trio
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Three sages, the Wise Trio, guard Bellchime Trail behind Ecruteak City's Bell Tower gate. Beat all three, then see Sage Li inside the Bell Tower: the Rainbow Wing opens the way to the top.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Legend of Mt. Silver
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The title is yours, yet people still whisper of a Trainer who climbed Mt. Silver and never came down. The mountain rises beyond the Silver League's gate, at the far end of Route 28.

steps.say: West of the Reception Gate, a quiet road winds toward a mountain few are allowed to climb.
Dark caves, a long climb, and snow at the very top. Someone is waiting up there.
steps.label: A silent Trainer

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Fire on the Mountain
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Heat shimmers deep inside Mt. Silver, in a chamber past its waterfalls. Something fiery roosts there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: To Kanto by Sea
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Prof. Elm's ticket is good for the S.S. Aqua. It sails from Olivine City's harbour to Vermilion City, in Kanto.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ruins of Alph
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The stones here hum with a strange frequency. Catch different forms of Unown to unlock the ruins' secrets.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Union Cave Mystery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: On Fridays, a rare Pokemon is said to appear in the deepest part of Union Cave. Have you found Lapras yet?

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Karate King
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deep inside Mt. Mortar, the Karate King awaits a challenger. Defeat him to receive a rare Fighting-type Pokemon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Special Delivery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A guard at Goldenrod's gate has a Spearow carrying a letter, and nobody to take it to his friend. The friend is somewhere on Route 31... asleep.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Pokemon to Mind
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A nervous man in Cianwood City needs someone to look after his Pokemon for a while. He won't say who he's hiding it from.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Elder's Gift
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Elder of the Dragon Shrine has one more thing for a trainer who answered his questions. Make room in your party first.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trading Partners
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: People all over Johto are hoping to swap one Pokemon for another. Bring them what they ask for and see what they give you back.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Bug-Catching Contest
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Bug Catchers gather in the National Park to see who can catch the best Bug Pokemon. The judges are strict, and first prize is something special.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: National Upgrade
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Word of a new Champion travels fast. Prof. Oak, in Pallet Town far across Kanto, has been hoping you would come. The S.S. Aqua sails from Olivine.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Kanto Challenge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A Champion of Johto, yet Kanto has eight Gyms of its own. The first, Brock's, stands in Pewter City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Johto Bound
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Visit Route 26 via Indigo Plateau to begin your journey into the Johto region.
